from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single month's residential construction data extracted from a document."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, format YYYY-MM")
    total_starts_saar: str | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    multifamily_starts_saar: str | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Housing Starts in buildings with five or more units")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="Release date of the source report to determine precedence")
    report_title: str | None = Field(description="Title of the source report")
    data_status: str | None = Field(description="Status of the data in this specific report (e.g. 'preliminary', 'revised')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_data_points: list[MonthlyDataPoint]
